Ticket 260825 (bootstrap-artifact-convergence) lands Phases 1-4 on ONE branch impl/develop/bootstrap-artifact-converge with ONE deferred merge + ONE version bump (agents-plugin-tool/scripts/bump-ws-version.sh) at the very end, after Phase 4. Rationale: batch all spec/doc reconciliation into Phase 4 so develop never sees the intra-branch doc-drift window.

Merge deferral: do NOT run the per-phase merge step for Phases 2 and 3; at each phase's final-action-gate, record 'merge deferred to post-Phase-4' and continue. Only after Phase 4 completes do the single final-action-gate + merge to develop (merge_confirm=ask, needs user approval) + version bump + ticket close/move.

Doc deferral (Phase 4-owned): (1) update spec anchors workflow-skills.md {#260513-wsflow-agentless-skill-surface} L253-257 ('package-local template version history' now false) and mcp-tools.md {#260703-bootstrap-staleness-warning} (now also warns on the above-head/unknown-tag direction, not just behind); (2) invert wsflow-mirroring.md L291-292 ('Keep bootstrap template version histories package-local'); (3) invert mental-model workflow-skills.md L85/L110/L119; (4) record the 260728 Non-Scope override; (5) rewrite the trimmed test_bootstrap_template_uses_wsflow_local_version_lineage into the positive convergence assertion (emitted-body identity + shared head) + guard-detection coverage; (6) NEW: document the skills-manifest regen step in wsflow-mirroring.md Rsrc/Skills provisioning -- editing any file under agents-plugin/skills/ (incl. lead-bootstrap templates) requires `WSRSRC_REGEN_SKILLS=1 go test ./internal/wsrsrc/... -run TestGenerateRealSkillsManifest` (the section currently documents only the rsrc-tree regen, which is why Phase 1/2 left agents-plugin/skills/manifest.json stale until Phase 3 caught it via TestSkillsManifestDriftIsVisible).

Review-surface gap to note in Phase 4/final report: the partitioned test-review for template-touching phases must run the Go drift suite (go test ./internal/wsrsrc/...), not only the wsflow Python suite -- Phase 1/2 test reviews missed the skills-manifest drift because they ran only Python.

Phase status: Phase 1 done (52fbf0bc + 103014f7), Phase 2 done (ee4bc6a5, counter unified to v0047, suite green), Phase 3 done (feature 21055a6f honest above-head/unknown-tag skew guard + skill refuse mode; skills-manifest regen fix a0267b1f; test hardening b119c658; all Go+Python suites green). Next: Phase 4 (test rewrite + doc/spec reconcile items 1-6 above), then the single merge + version bump + ticket close.
